#### The best single number (part 2)

Again, $Y$ is next year's burglary count in a randomly chosen neighborhood,
and $c$ is a single number predicted for every neighborhood.

What is the smallest [expected squared error](expectation.qmd#def-squared-error-risk) that any [constant](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#def-constant-function) [prediction](expectation.qmd#def-prediction) can achieve?
